summary: The contradiction argument correctly reduces every putative counterexample with r at least 1/2 to the residual interval 1/2 at most r less than r_0, proves S_c(r) at least 1+r/2 there with reversible squaring and correct endpoint signs, and then invokes the accepted localization theorem under its exact midpoint-containment and area hypotheses. All relevant strict and nonstrict endpoints are handled.
